meta.title: Official-only correlations - computed from the 2026-11-18 standings capture
meta.method: Pearson r on club-level season totals taken from the NFL's own standings table; 95 % interval by Fisher's z transform (NIST Dataplot reference). No third-party or nflverse number enters any coefficient.
meta.sample: 2026 regular season through Week 10, one observation per club

rows.interpretation: Does the league table reward net points, i.e. is net points a usable team-strength signal?
rows.input: official 2026 standings rows read 2026-11-18; every point total comes from the standings table, none from a third party
rows.sample_note: n = 32 of 32 clubs, the whole readable table. 24 clubs' points were read at 2026-11-18T03:55:00Z; the 8 in NFC South and NFC West at 2026-11-18T04:21:00Z, when the retrieval chunk that had failed was re-read from the same URL. The sample was n=24 for four minutes of this session and the register says so rather than back-dating the second read onto the first.
